title: Depth Pro 2 model card
blurb: Apple's Hub card for Depth Pro 2: sharp, temporally consistent metric monocular depth for photos, video, and live feeds at the input's full resolution. Lists the four sizes, the shared focal estimator, the quick start, and the research-only Apple ML Research Model license (apple-amlr).

title: Depth Pro 2 project page
blurb: Official project site with image and video comparisons, the method figure, and the claim that Depth Pro 2 outperforms prior single-frame and multi-frame work on Boundary F1 sharpness and temporal jitter, averaged over Sintel and Spring.

title: ml-depth-pro-2
blurb: Official inference code and CLI. Install with pip from this repo, or clone and run uv run depth-pro-2 predict. The README says the repository does not include training or evaluation code. The code license is Apple's software license; the weights are under LICENSE_MODEL.

title: Depth Pro 2 paper
blurb: Hu, Mihajlovic, Duong, Lipson, Dong, Delaunoy, Richter, and Koltun, Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth, arXiv:2611.26603, submitted 19 November 2026.

title: Apple ML Research Model license
blurb: LICENSE_MODEL for the Depth Pro 2 weights. The grant is limited to Research Purposes, defined as non-commercial scientific research and academic development, and it excludes commercial product or service use.

title: Depth Pro 2 S
blurb: Smallest public size: 24M parameters, 97 MB download, Hub id apple/DepthPro2-S. Official guidance is to start with S on a laptop. Same apple-amlr research-only license as the rest of the family.

title: Depth Pro 2 B
blurb: 97M parameters, 386 MB download, Hub id apple/DepthPro2-B. Larger sizes are described as sharper and steadier; smaller ones run faster. Research-only apple-amlr license.

title: Depth Pro 2 L
blurb: 334M parameters, 1.3 GB download, Hub id apple/DepthPro2-L. Research-only apple-amlr license.

title: Depth Pro 2 H+
blurb: Largest public size and the default in the official CLI: 872M parameters, 3.5 GB download, Hub id apple/DepthPro2-H (H+ on the card). Research-only apple-amlr license.

title: Depth Pro 2 focal estimator
blurb: Shared 23.5M-parameter (94 MB) focal-length estimator, Hub id apple/DepthPro2-focal. It loads with each size and predicts focal length in pixels when the camera does not report one. Same research-only license.

title: Depth Pro 2 Core ML
blurb: Official Core ML packages for S, B, L, H+, and a field-of-view model, for Apple silicon on macOS 15 or later. The card documents w4 temporal windows, named input sizes, and that inverse depth is normalized by focal length. Research-only apple-amlr license.

title: Depth Pro 2 Mac demo
blurb: Official demo README for a minimal Mac app that shows live camera depth with Core ML, including how to export a package and use it in an app. Requires Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later, and Xcode 16 or later or its command line tools.

title: Depth Pro 2 Space (akhaliq)
blurb: Community Gradio Space for metric monocular depth from photos and videos. The official Space linked from the project page returned 401 to this checker and is not listed.

title: ml-depth-pro
blurb: Official code for Depth Pro, Apple's 2024 metric monocular depth model. The older apple/ml-depth-pro URL now redirects here.

title: Depth Pro weights
blurb: Hub weights for Depth Pro v1. The Hub license field is apple-amlr, the same research-license family as Depth Pro 2.

title: Depth Pro (transformers)
blurb: Hub checkpoint used by the Hugging Face transformers DepthPro model. The transformers docs target this v1 line, not Depth Pro 2.

title: Depth Pro paper
blurb: Bochkovskii et al., Depth Pro: Sharp Monocular Metric Depth in Less Than a Second, arXiv:2410.02073.

title: Depth Pro research page
blurb: Apple ML Research page for the original Depth Pro. A corresponding depth-pro-2 research page was not up (404) when this list was built.

A plain transformer predicts spatially consistent geometry from any number of views, with or without known poses, and the authors also report monocular depth against Depth Anything V2. Apache-2.0. Trained, the repo says, exclusively on public academic datasets.
